senses.gloss: (b. h.; שָׂרַף I)burning, venomous serpent (v. Sm. Dict. s. v. Dipsas).
units: Gen. R. s. 44; Lev. R. s. 13 (ref. to Deut. VIII, 15) ש׳ זו מדי saraf refers to Media; a. e.—Pl. שְׂרָפִים.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:23">Num. R. s. 19<sup>22</sup></cite> <he>הנחשים הש׳ ששורפים את הנפש</he> they are called burning serpents, because they burn the life out (with thirst); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 764:19">Yalk. ib. 764</cite>; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 19.
